verifiedLines.text: Stop spending four hours editing a single vertical reel!
Here is how automated timeline cutting works.
[Umm, so basically... wait let me check my notes]
Step one: drop your raw MP4 into the silence detector.
[8 seconds dead air looking at camera]
Every pause longer than 400 milliseconds gets marked.
[Uhh, like, you know what I mean]
Step two: review the striped edit plan before cutting.
Red blocks stay in the reel and hatched blocks get cut.
[Repeated take: let me start that sentence over again]
Step three: lock the 9:16 portrait crop onto your face.
Even if you move slightly, the speaker stays centered.
[5 seconds coughing and adjusting microphone]
Step four: burn in bold captions with active word highlight.
Viewers watching on mute can follow every single word.
[Umm, wait, one more thing]
Step five: add a 2-second opening title card.
Smooth audio fades prevent harsh clicks between cuts.
No sentence is ever cut off in the middle.
Click render reel and your 58-second vertical clip is ready!
